description: Run a read-only GAQL query and return rows — for looking up campaign/budget/ad_group/criterion IDs without the google-ads MCP. SELECT queries only. Refs #5745.

customerId.description: Google Ads customer ID. Defaults to GOOGLE_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID env var.

gaql.description: A GAQL SELECT query, e.g. "SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name FROM campaign".
